exposure: Women who initiated SAPT during pregnancy
Women who initiated SAPT before pregnancy
finding: In pregnant patients with T1D and high risk of hypoglycemia, SAPT and SAPT + LGS should be considered as a therapeutic alternative for A1c reduction with a low risk of SH.
mod_finding: 91.1% underwent cesarean section, the main reasons being iterative cesarean (30%), fetal distress (20%), and preeclampsia (16%).
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 37 weeks
